status: Dependency audit for next common operation; not an implemented GPU counter

observed_in_current_sources.team_hit_stream: GPU weapon callbacks pass1-core into body/part team-hit events. These events cannot stand for all accepted hits.
observed_in_current_sources.source_ammo_stream: Ammo-consume events represent shots/resource accounting, not selected enemy identity or accepted hit count.
observed_in_current_sources.accepted_damage_stream: CPU _land_boss/_land_target gate actual target acceptance; HitEvent already carries target/to/part tags but has no explicit reusable target-generation and hit-credit contract.
observed_in_current_sources.raw_capture_order: Current capture then cap-conditioned overflow ordering can fire overflow on the capture that first reaches cap. Game-facing description says capture while already at cap; order/snapshot must be corrected together with data migration.
observed_in_current_sources.target_death: Possessed-target death also completes capture, but the current ammo-only trigger does not represent that route.

common_contract_requirements: Target handle includes identity and generation, independent of marker lifetime.
Counter key includes exact marker carrier UID/generation and target handle; refresh/replacement/retirement cannot inherit another lifetime accidentally.
Explicit accepted-hit credit independent of ammo, core classification and damage routing weights. Declare contributing hit families instead of assuming all damage or all weapon events.
Latch completion before synchronous children; deliver completion once with marker/target context; retire only that same carrier generation after children.
Target-death completion and threshold completion in the same frame must not grant twice.
Resource cap condition at capture entry must remain distinct from the value after capture; define via authored effect ordering or an explicit snapshot.
Use typed target/landing packets as the common boundary for future projectile/shield bonuses; do not map every target to the boss.

next_event_contract.event_frames: Target/impact context belongs in the shared nested event frame. Explicitly inherit it for hit/completion events and clear it for ammo/reload events; no global unscoped last-target variable.
next_event_contract.refresh: Data must explicitly choose reset or preserve; refreshing an existing carrier can require a new counter epoch even when its carrier UID is reused.
next_event_contract.completion: Latch completion before children. After children, retire only the same counter epoch; a refreshed/reused carrier must survive. Death and threshold completion cannot both grant.
next_event_contract.contributing_hits: Declare allowed hit families, accepted outcomes and any attack/component deduplication policy. A blocked hit is not necessarily a miss; current damage-gate bool alone cannot decide capture eligibility.

game_rule_evidence_still_needed: Which skill/DoT/weapon/pellet hits count toward capture, including blocked hits
Whether multiple component impacts of one projectile count once or separately for the logical enemy
Counter progress policy when possession refreshes on the same target
